about: Army collection: groups of cards. Unlocked items with metaKey level up through META.lv[metaKey] (same multipliers the battle uses, meta.json 'per'). The equipped comeback (cb0 wave / cb1 barricade) is what fires in battle when the base drops low.

items.name: Guardian
items.desc: A sturdy all-rounder. Steady fire rate and solid damage.

items.name: Rhino
items.desc: Heavy armor plates, slow but tough.

items.name: Viper
items.desc: Light and quick, fires in rapid bursts.

items.name: Titan
items.desc: Massive cannon that crushes trees in one shot.

items.name: Blaze
items.desc: Shells set the forest on fire.

items.name: Frost
items.desc: Freezing rounds slow enemy troops.

items.name: Thunder
items.desc: Chain lightning jumps between targets.

items.name: Phantom
items.desc: Fires piercing ghost bullets.

items.name: Rookie
items.desc: Brave little soldier. Marches down the road and fights in melee.

items.name: Brawler
items.desc: Big fists, more health.

items.name: Scout
items.desc: Fast runner that slips past the front line.

items.name: Grenadier
items.desc: Throws grenades over the trees.

items.name: Knight
items.desc: Shielded and hard to push back.

items.name: Ninja
items.desc: Strikes fast and dodges hits.

items.name: Medic
items.desc: Heals nearby soldiers.

items.name: Berserker
items.desc: Hits harder as it loses health.

items.name: Roller
items.desc: Rolling cannon that drives down the road and shells everything in its lane.

items.name: Bulldog
items.desc: Pushes soldiers aside with its plow.

items.name: Mammoth
items.desc: Twin cannons, double the shells.

items.name: Hornet
items.desc: Fast tank with homing missiles.

items.name: Crusher
items.desc: Flattens fences on contact.

items.name: Inferno
items.desc: Flamethrower tank.

items.name: Glacier
items.desc: Shells freeze the ground.

items.name: Goliath
items.desc: Slow giant with a huge health pool.

items.name: Double Fire
items.desc: Two blazing bullets for a few seconds.

items.name: Rocket Rain
items.desc: Rockets fall across the enemy half.

items.name: Shield Dome
items.desc: Your base takes no damage for a moment.

items.name: Time Stop
items.desc: Freezes enemy troops in place.

items.name: Shock Wave
items.desc: When your base drops low, a free wave rolls out and pushes enemies back.

items.name: Barricade
items.desc: When your base drops low, a wide fence slides out and blocks the road.

items.name: Air Strike
items.desc: Bombers hit the enemy front line.

items.name: Last Stand
items.desc: Your cannon fires twice as fast for a while.

items.name: Oil Barrel
items.desc: Rolls down the road, bursts on the first enemy and leaves burning oil.

items.name: Land Mine
items.desc: Hidden trap that blows up the first soldier.

items.name: Bomb Crate
items.desc: Big blast, short fuse.

items.name: Smoke Bomb
items.desc: Enemies inside the cloud move slower.
